dataset.name: SECOM
dataset.task: Binary classification for wafer-lot failure risk prioritization

preprocessing.missingness_rule: Drop features above 60% missingness, median-impute the rest
preprocessing.split_strategy: Chronological 80/20 holdout to emulate future-lot scoring

model.name: Class-weighted logistic regression
model.selection_reason: Logistic regression remains the published portfolio model because it keeps coefficient-level interpretability for stakeholder review while remaining competitive with the higher-capacity random forest benchmark on the same chronological holdout.

benchmarks.name: Naive prior baseline
benchmarks.description: Dummy classifier that predicts the historical class prior.

benchmarks.name: Class-weighted logistic regression
benchmarks.description: Interpretable linear baseline with class balancing and coefficient-level visibility.

benchmarks.name: Balanced random forest
benchmarks.description: Higher-capacity tree ensemble benchmark for non-linear sensor interactions.

benchmarks.name: HistGradientBoosting with feature selection
benchmarks.description: Native-NaN gradient boosting with SelectKBest feature selection (top-50 sensors). No imputation required.

time_series_cv.interpretation: Mean ROC-AUC across 5 CV folds: 0.6262 ± 0.1146. Stable AUC across folds indicates low temporal drift risk. Declining AUC in later folds suggests process drift and the need for more frequent retraining.

calibration.interpretation: ECE = 0.0755. Lower ECE = better calibration. Values below 0.05 indicate the model's predicted probabilities match observed failure rates.

portfolio_summary.problem_statement: Prioritize limited engineering review capacity toward the lots most likely to fail.
portfolio_summary.why_ranking_not_threshold: The plant only has capacity to review a small share of lots per shift, so risk ranking is more realistic than a fixed 0.50 classifier threshold.
portfolio_summary.headline_result: At a 10% review budget, the model surfaces 29.4% of failures with 2.89x the failure yield of random review.

experiment_log.takeaway: The dummy prior model establishes a floor at ROC-AUC 0.500 and PR-AUC 0.054, confirming that class imbalance alone does not solve the ranking problem.
Class-weighted logistic regression lifts PR-AUC to 0.174 and keeps the strongest coefficient signals inspectable for operations stakeholders.
Random forest was tested as a non-linear benchmark and reached PR-AUC 0.069; the published portfolio model stays logistic to preserve simpler explanation surfaces and coefficient visibility.
HistGradientBoosting with SelectKBest (top-50 sensors) was evaluated as a no-imputation, feature-selection-enabled alternative. Handles NaN natively; coefficients are not directly inspectable.
